topic: Factors affecting climate and global climate phenomena
key_concepts: Latitude affects the temperature and climate of an area
Higher altitude areas are cooler than lowland areas
Mountain ranges can reduce the impact of typhoons
Coastal areas are cooler than inland areas
Distance from bodies of water leads to more extreme climates
Global warming is the ongoing rise in global average temperature near Earth's surface
Burning fossil fuels causes global warming
Melting glaciers is an effect of global warming
El Niño occurs when the eastern Pacific temperature rises above normal
El Niño is associated with weaker trade winds and drought
La Niña involves intense upwelling of cold water and extreme flooding
Deforestation, vehicle pollution, and quarrying contribute to global warming
